label: D134: CLAUDE.md consistency check 4, one name with two definitions, raised before SimpleStream and QDP are ported. Static reading of committed code; nothing re-run.

decision_posted.default: SimpleStream and QueryStream QDP are charged by the COMMITTED CHARGING DEFINITION, RECENT_WINDOW_TOKENS = 467 (cstate.py:50), which tokens_for_representation applies as max(min(467, whole_history), 1).
decision_posted.reason: SimpleStream card window is ABSOLUTE, not proportional. simplestream_adapted.py:33 states "A window is expressed as the number of 0.25-s grid steps of history", with candidates {4, 12, 20, 40} steps and 4 fitted on the StudyD3 development split. An absolute window is the same FAMILY as a fixed token count and a different family from a fraction of history, so 467 is the right shape for this arm and 0.35 x history is not.

but_the_framing_needs_correcting.claim_examined: that RECENT has two COMMITTED DEFINITIONS competing for the charging path.
but_the_framing_needs_correcting.finding: it does not. There is ONE charging definition and ONE arm internal estimate, and they occupy different roles.
evidence: RECENT_WINDOW_TOKENS = 467 is the charging definition, read by cstate.tokens_for_representation and through it by coordinator._submit_recall at :552.

REP_TOKEN_SCALE["RECENT"] = 0.35 occurs in ecollm_adapted.py ONLY. A grep for REP_TOKEN_SCALE and for "* 0.35" across all of baselines/*.py returns no other file. It is used at ecollm_adapted.py:84 inside eco-llm own planner to price candidate representations against each other, and it reaches no charging path.
but_the_framing_needs_correcting.consequence: the risk is NOT that SimpleStream gets charged the wrong number. Its card implies an absolute window and the charging definition is absolute.

the_real_defect_is_elsewhere_and_is_wors.what: eco-llm now PLANS against 0.35 x history while being CHARGED min(467, history). Its optimiser prices RECENT wrongly against every alternative.
the_real_defect_is_elsewhere_and_is_wors.direction: below a history of about 1334 tokens eco-llm UNDER-estimates the cost of RECENT; above it, it OVER-estimates. The Part A measurement puts real histories at 5,431 to 14,881 tokens, far above the crossover, so in practice eco-llm over-estimates RECENT cost by up to about 9x and therefore UNDER-SELECTS RECENT exactly where RECENT is cheapest.
the_real_defect_is_elsewhere_and_is_wors.why_it_matters: eco-llm is the comparator, and it emits RECENT about once in twenty recalls. A comparator that mis-prices the cheap option against itself will understate what a correctly-priced version of the same policy achieves, so the bar it sets is too low in a direction that flatters everything measured against it.
the_real_defect_is_elsewhere_and_is_wors.class_of_fault: an arm internal estimate diverging from the quantity actually charged. Same class as my own S2 estimator fault, where the admission estimate was LlfArm S_hat rather than B7 and the proof passed only by regime coincidence. There the divergence was masked; here it is live in the comparator.
the_real_defect_is_elsewhere_and_is_wors.recommended: NOT resolved here, per the instruction to flag rather than resolve silently. Either eco-llm estimate is reconciled to the charging definition, or the divergence is declared as part of its card and its results labelled as planned-under-different-prices.

residual_conflict_that_remains_real.what: 467 is StudyF4 Part A median input size at N = 1. SimpleStream own fitted window is 4 grid steps of 0.25 s, i.e. 1 s of history. These are not the same quantity.
residual_conflict_that_remains_real.status: the SHAPE is right and the VALUE is an approximation. The port is charged a committed absolute window rather than this arm own fitted one.
residual_conflict_that_remains_real.flagged_not_resolved: changing the charged value to SimpleStream fitted window would be a methodological change, which CLAUDE.md requires be discussed before application, so it is raised and left.

static_method_correction.what: my earlier channel sweeps used grep for representation= and concluded no arm emits RECENT.
static_method_correction.correction: eco-llm selects from REPS = ("RECENT", "D2", "RICH") at RUNTIME, so a static grep cannot see it. eco-llm does emit RECENT, reportedly about once in twenty.
static_method_correction.significance: substance unchanged, roughly one emission in 240 is still a rarely-exercised channel, but this is the first time a static read gave the WRONG ANSWER about how live a channel was. Recorded beside the order, desired_tier, representation and reads_device_answer checks so the method limit travels with the results it produced.

_provenance.script: static reading of cstate.py, coordinator.py, ecollm_adapted.py, simplestream_adapted.py; nothing run
